summary: Newell Brands filed an 8-K on October 2, 2026 disclosing renewal and Second Amendment of its Receivables Purchase Agreement dated October 2, 2023, executed through bankruptcy-remote subsidiary Jarden Receivables, LLC with Royal Bank of Canada as Administrative Agent. The scheduled termination date extends to October 1, 2027, the facility limit on factored receivables is set at $75 million, obligor concentration limits increase, and the Debt Rating definition shifts to corporate ratings with revised rating-period thresholds. This is a routine credit-facility amendment, not a special situation; no equity, control, or deal terms are implicated.
